name: Hiota no Kanojo ga Ore no Motteru Eroge ni Kyoumi Shinshin Nanda ga......
original_name: 非オタの彼女が俺の持ってるエロゲに興味津々なんだが……
source:
"I want you to make me your... slave (girlfriend)"

The high school student and eroge-lover Kazuma was confessed by the school's number 1, honor student Misaki Honoka. Moreover, Honoka proclaims that she will do her best to become Kazuma's favorite heroine. "Can you train me...?"

What is this, an eroge?

[Translated from [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DACxTn-Ni-0]YouTube description[/url]]

Short visual novel free for download to advertise the light novel.
translation:
“我想让你成为我的……奴隶（女朋友）。”

高中生兼色情游戏爱好者一马被学校第一名的优等生穗香告白。更进一步，穗香宣称自己会努力成为一马最喜欢的女主角。

“你能训练我吗……？”

这是什么，色情游戏吗？

[译自[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DACxTn-Ni-0]YouTube简介[/url]]

这是为宣传轻小说而免费下载的短篇视觉小说。
